summary: Treat executable evidence as the acceptance boundary for consequential code changes.
instructions: State the behavior contract and forbidden regressions before changing research-critical code.
Observe a relevant failure or establish a reproducible baseline, make the minimum change, then run risk-calibrated checks.
Report only fresh command results; never infer a pass from code inspection or an unrelated test.
Do not weaken tests, metrics, thresholds, or error handling to obtain GREEN.
